Debug-signed demo APK (package `org.darter.smoke`, arm64-v8a) built by CI
from this tag. Sideload it; tested on an Android 16 phone with an Adreno 830.

The app opens on an area picker (city, suburb, coast, hills) showing the
OpenStreetMap and Copernicus DEM attribution; each area plays a recorded
20-second demo flight through six gates scored in the HUD. Flying with a
controller is not part of this release; the milestone list is in
`VISION.md`.
